name: Anicca
description: Anicca is a daily affirmation app for iPhone. You pick the areas you want support with — self-criticism, overthinking, anxiety and more — enable notifications, and receive short affirmation cards during the day. There are no streaks and nothing to catch up on when you miss a day. Free to download, with an optional in-app subscription.
capabilities: Daily affirmation cards delivered by notification
Personalized support topics (self-criticism, overthinking, anxiety, and more)
No streaks and nothing to catch up on after a missed day
